{"step":2,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_filter.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":18,"var":"pkts","code":"pkts = pcap_open_dead(Data[Size-1], 0xFFFF);","note":"The last byte selects the link-layer type for the compiler context, influencing how the filter is optimized."},
{"step":3,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/testprogs/fuzz/fuzz_filter.c","function":"LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput","line":23,"var":"filter","code":"filter = malloc(Size); memcpy(filter, Data, Size); filter[Size-1] = 0;","note":"The preceding bytes become the textual filter expression exactly as chosen by the attacker."},
{"step":4,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/gencode.c","function":"pcap_compile","line":760,"var":"scanner input","code":"in_buffer = pcap__scan_string(xbuf ? xbuf : \"\", scanner);","note":"The input string is fed to the parser to produce the internal compiler graph and instruction blocks."},
{"step":5,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/gencode.c","function":"pcap_compile","line":798,"var":"cstate.ic","code":"if (bpf_optimize(&cstate.ic, p->errbuf) == -1) { ... }","note":"The parsed graph is sent into the optimizer, where the reported crash state begins."},
{"step":6,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"bpf_optimize","line":1904,"var":"opt_state.top_ctx","code":"if (setjmp(opt_state.top_ctx)) { opt_cleanup(&opt_state); return -1; }","note":"Any optimization error unwinds through this setjmp handler and immediately frees optimizer-owned allocations."},
{"step":7,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"bpf_optimize","line":1925,"var":"opt_state","code":"opt_cleanup(&opt_state);","note":"After successful optimization, the same cleanup routine runs again on the same state object."},
{"step":8,"file":"repo-vul/src-vul/libpcap/optimize.c","function":"opt_cleanup","line":2030,"var":"opt_state->blocks","code":"free((void *)opt_state->blocks);","note":"The cleanup routine frees the heap graph; the vulnerability is that the same heap pointer can be released twice along the error/success interaction."}
]
Path('/workspace/candidate_trace.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace, indent=2)+'\n')
print('trace written')
